text: Picked up the PC's undertone handoff on the Mac: repo already at 0.4.0 (d980922), bridge restarted detached from the repo on 0.4.0 (no sources here, as expected); next pick is roadmap Next #1 timesheets (waiting on TS-logs) or #2 the self-starting bridge
undertone engines: after a first listen the user leans Synth ('very clean'), not final yet

TS-logs: undertone timesheets come from a small daily summary per machine (per project: minutes worked, blocked on you, broken by check, counts), synced through the brain repo; raw logs stay local. A real DB waits until the home dashboard needs queries. The user wants data only when it isn't noise

undertone 0.6.0 (aab90b6): the first session starts the bridge detached via bridge/launch.mjs (log ~/.undertone/bridge.log); an --auto bridge leaves after a quiet hour (no Claude lanes, no page, no sources); /undertone stop leaves ~/.undertone/stopped until /undertone or npm start; setting bridge: auto|manual

undertone 0.6 on the PC: update (claude plugin marketplace update coter-kit, then claude plugin update undertone@coter-kit), close any old bridge window, start a session and confirm a detached bridge comes up (the Windows detached start is proven only in tests so far)
done: the self-starting bridge shipped in 0.6.0; the Mac runs it detached from the repo (PID 20966) and its plugin is updated to 0.6.0

undertone Synth: the user loves the busy sound (5 sessions, Daylight mood, drums full) but finds it 'a little poppy at times'; their 18:31 love clip has 18 clicks/min (most today, no clipping) and Gemini flags the snare/rim snap and the bass attack blurring into the kick. First targets for the tuning loop

undertone pops (0.6.3, 2124e76): a Tone.js bus mixing a mono kick with stereo noise flips channel count each hit and Chrome resets the filters after it, a spike on a 128-sample block boundary; pinning buses to 2 channels (kit.stereo) took 16-24 clicks/min to 0. The ears now record via AudioWorklet (the old ScriptProcessor dropped audio while the page drew)

undertone Synth tuning round 1 shipped in 0.6.3 (pops fixed, softer snare, kick ducks bass, laid-back hats); the user should reload the page and judge by ear. Gemini critique of the before/after clips waits for the key's daily quota to reset (scratch clips used it up 10-3)

undertone 0.7.0 (14a785d): GitHub Actions source (sources/github-actions.mjs, an entry with "github" in sources.json): builds starting/finishing play, a red workflow holds ci:<workflow>. The Mac now watches jobsnearme-ci (~/.config/undertone/sources.json), so its bridge stays up; JoinOurPlace left out because its Deploy API has been red since 9-1

undertone's drone keeps counting waiting questions from coter-kit's journal, not the M2 live status files: live files only cover each session's own project on its own machine for 7 days (would drop xcombaby and PC-only projects); the journal takes 2 ms and the counts agree. Revisit if coter-kit writes one all-projects count file

undertone scheduled runs (concurrent-bots-loop) are quiet and never call since 10-03 16:13, when the Mac's plugin update brought the scheduled flag; the coter-kit build-plan item about it describes the morning before
Sound design: no constant tones for status. Alex called undertone's waiting drone 'a lawnmower... vmmmm' and wants that kind of info told 'through the vibes' (occasional musical figures), not a hum

undertone 0.7.1 (8caa574): the waiting-questions drone is gone; the conductor asks instead (a soft rising bell figure ending on the open 9th; every 32/24/16 bars and 2/3/4 notes for 1-3/4-9/10+ questions; a new question asks at once)

JoinOurPlace's 'Deploy API' GitHub workflow has failed every run on main since 9-1: Azure setup left by the previous dev, which Alex is tracking down. undertone leaves it out of its GitHub sources until then
